why: Rethrows without stopping, which is the defect issue #690 describes: the frame requests its successor before doing its work, so a throw leaves that frame queued and the loop keeps running -- throwing identically every frame when the cause persists, or silently carrying on past a failure the page has just been told about when it does not.
killedBy: driver: lifecycle a frame that throws stops the loop, so the throw surfaces once rather than every frame (#690)
